customManagers.description: The snapshot of the debian archive the images are built at. snapshot.yml writes the newest snapshots, when they change a published image, to the snapshot-feed branch; this moves lock.json's debian_snapshots to it. The quote after debian keeps it off the debian-security line.
The snapshot of the debian-security archive the images are built at: the same feed branch, its own file, its own line in lock.json's debian_snapshots.
The factory's builder image, by tag and digest. It moves with the factory's .pyz in lock.json, in one pull request.

packageRules.description: A new Action version waits three days before its pull request: an Action runs with the workflow's token, and a bad release is usually withdrawn within that time. Image inputs do not wait.
Each Node.js image follows one LTS line: Renovate moves its version inside that major only. A new LTS line gets a new image by hand (DESIGN.md, section 3).
The factory's .pyz and its builder image move together: builder.ref changes in the same pull request (scripts/policy.py refuses a mismatch).
The snapshots of both Debian archives move in one pull request, replaced while it waits, and it merges like every other update once CI passes.
prBodyNotes: snapshot.yml found that these snapshots change a published image: a Debian upload (often a security fix) touched one of their packages.
